reference.title: Scenario 3: using <keydef> to define reusable keys
reference.shortdesc: Scenario 3: using <keydef> to define reusable keys You are maintaining multiple guides for the

section.p: You are maintaining multiple guides for the same product line (Quick Start, Admin Guide, API Reference) and need to keep product names, URLs, and common topics consistent across all outputs. You also publish frequently updated release notes and support contacts.

You define keys in a central map (or a shared map) and reuse them everywhere:<map> <title>Shared Keys – Product Line A</title> <keydef keys="product-name"> <topicmeta> <linktext>Product Line A</linktext> </topicmeta> </keydef> <keydef keys="latest-release-notes" href="r_release_notes_2026.dita"/> <keydef keys="admin-guide" href="admin_guide.ditamap"/> <keydef keys="support-contact" href="mailto:support@company.com"/> </map>

Then in your individual DITA maps you consume those keys: Quick Start Guide The keyref="product-name" quick start guide helps you set up the core components. What’s New in Full Administration Guide Get Help
